title: Lab 1
text:
Download this page as PDF
Ungraded Tuesday lab (~80 min). Paper quiz Friday from the Quiz 1 study bank (this lab + Ch. 1).

Open in Colab



Open In Colab


Notebook file: lab-01.ipynb.


What you will do
Review the four steps of supervised learning (§1.3) for logistic regression, with the math in the notebook. Fit one 2-D example the DATA 322 way (sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression / LogisticRegression and statsmodels Logit), then rebuild the same example in PyTorch using only nn.Sequential + sigmoid + BCELoss.


Project (separate)
Project 1 week 1 uses the wildfire table. That stone uses logits + BCEWithLogitsLoss (same logistic model, different wrapper).
